Flight Phase

मैक संख्या

The ratio of the true airspeed of an aircraft to the speed of sound under the same atmospheric conditions. Used in ATC for speed assignments and reporting in high-speed flight.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

The ratio of the true airspeed of an aircraft to the speed of sound under the same atmospheric conditions. Used in ATC for speed assignments and reporting in high-speed flight.

Operational example

Maintain Mach decimal eight zero or greater, advise if unable due to turbulence or performance limitations.

Localized term

मैक संख्या
